question: Can bounded, traceable Q01 B-Rep facts inform a generated Q02 build script while the executed script has no capability to read the original STEP?
model_class: tool-assisted B-Rep-to-CAD script construction under a capability-separated offline sandbox

required_facts: an opaque observation_session_id bound to one record revision and selected local input
validated Q01 calls and bounded structured responses from probe_summary, probe_topology, probe_entity, and sample_entity
a local query log containing call order, arguments, result digest, byte count, timeout outcome, and unsupported disposition
a build-capability attestation showing no original STEP mount or observation-tool endpoint during build execution
ADR-0048 normal-run and absent-input provenance evidence plus unchanged geometry gates
ambiguity_or_fail_closed_conditions: a tool response contains raw STEP bytes, host paths, a local overflow trace path, a reference script, or a history label
a requested fact requires unbounded traversal or is not available from the four frozen tools
a query, result digest, capability attestation, tracer coverage, or absent-input control is missing
the build process can resolve /input/model.step, the selected record input, or an observation endpoint

constrained_hypothesis: A bounded observation transcript can provide auditable geometric facts for script construction without granting the build process raw-file access. This is a capability contract, not evidence of feature-history recovery, editability, or model quality.

gate_or_diagnostic: observation-session start/end trace and one JSONL entry per validated tool call
canonical-JSON SHA-256 digest and byte count for every response supplied to the runtime LLM
build-capability attestation listing mount absence and disabled observation-tool endpoint
ADR-0048 provenance classification and existing script/readability/bbox/volume/topology gates
stopping_rule: no provider request, prompt implementation, raw STEP egress, case/manifest update, or runtime code change under this design package
return structured unsupported rather than traversing beyond the frozen tool and response limits
do not expose local trace paths or overflow payloads to the runtime LLM
if a build capability cannot prove that /input/model.step and observation tools are unavailable, classify provenance_unknown
do not treat an observation transcript, a geometry pass, or a self-authored reference script as feature-history evidence

existing: The current BRepToolBridge already bounds calls, entity counts, samples, and result bytes for four structured probe tools.
ADR-0048 and M46 show that executed input access must be classified separately from geometry success and fails closed when coverage is unresolved.
missing_counterexample: a later G2 fixture proving that no raw input path or overflow trace is visible in the observation transcript supplied to the runtime LLM
a later G2 fixture proving that a build script cannot access the original STEP after successful Q01 calls
a later G2 fixture proving that a missing query/capability attestation remains unsupported or provenance_unknown
evidence.next_minimal_experiment: Select one offline G2 implementation workpack with no provider. Freeze a local box input and six fixtures: direct round-trip negative control; valid bounded Q01 observation followed by independently constructed build; invalid arguments; budget or response-bound exceedance; attempted build read of /input/model.step; and missing tracer/capability attestation. Reference scripts must not be supplied as runtime-LLM inputs.

not_authorized: raw STEP text or host-path exposure
